---
# Course-wide knitr / Quarto defaults.
# Pages should include this file and then load only the packages that lesson needs.
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    echo: true
    warning: false
    message: false
    fig-align: center
    fig-width: 6
    fig-asp: 0.618
    dpi: 96
    out-width: "75%"
    # ragg is fine for points/lines; fonts are registered with systemfonts below
    # so ggrepel can see the same families. Do not pair ragg with showtext-only fonts.
    dev: "ragg_png"
---

```{r}
#| label: claude_made_setup
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(systemfonts)
library(ggplot2)
##
systemfonts::require_font("Alegreya")
systemfonts::require_font("Roboto Condensed")

theme_madhatter <- function(base_size = 10, paper = "bisque") {
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = base_size,
           base_family = "Roboto Condensed",
           header_family = "Alegreya",
           paper = paper) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0.5, r = 0.5, b = 0.5, l = 0.5, unit = "cm"),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Roboto Condensed",
        size = 10
      ),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Roboto Condensed",
        size = 8
      ),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Roboto Condensed",
        size = 8
      ),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 10
      ),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 16,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 12
      ),
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
        family = "Alegreya",
        size = 8
      ),
      plot.caption.position = "plot"
    )
  
}
ggplot2::theme_set(theme_madhatter())

```
